name: SeatGeek
page_total_how: seatgeek.com/jobs answers headless Chromium with 403 and a DataDome CAPTCHA, which I did not bypass. job-boards.greenhouse.io/seatgeek 302-redirects to seatgeek.com/jobs. A Playwright render of the GH embed view https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/embed/job_board?for=seatgeek (robots ALLOW) showed '37 jobs' with 37 links seatgeek.com/jobs/<id>?gh_jid=<id>, identical to the feed ids
robots: ALLOW (no matching rule; boards-api.greenhouse.io only disallows /embed/); seatgeek.com robots.txt is itself 403 (DataDome), but the checker never touches seatgeek.com
notes: The front-end is bot-protected, so the checker must only call the GH API, which is open. Every absolute_url points to seatgeek.com/jobs/<id>?gh_jid=<id>, which confirms the site renders this board. See discovery/notes/seatgeek.md.
